title: Reconcile historical CCP coverage with revision 2
description:
Scope: /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/docs/spec-coverage/02a-coordinated-capacity.md and /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/docs/spec-coverage/02a-coordinated-capacity-flagged.md. Preserve dated historical evidence while marking superseded density/SF/CH0 and continuous-reception claims as legacy, and link current requirements to actual CCP2 software evidence. Reconcile remaining documentary work associated with worker6-0aod and the CCP portion of worker6-b7z9. The Rule 0x08 decision and b7z9.21/4e0t closures are settled; do not create another adjudication or assume old implemented labels prove CCP2.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Make targeted annotations and current-evidence links rather than replacing historical reports wholesale. Reuse existing issue evidence without mutating those records as part of this input definition.
acceptance_criteria: Current normative guidance no longer treats density-driven receiver retuning, SF escalation, anonymous assignments or impossible simultaneous CH0 reception as CCP2 requirements. Historical results remain dated and distinguish helper fixes from integrated conformance. Links to independent corpus classification and actual joined results resolve. Any remaining 0aod documentary discrepancy is verified against the accepted fixed-uncompressed-beacon decision, not a reopened design choice. Unrelated coverage and test expectations remain untouched.
